protocol_section: Project Owner data handling and withdrawal wording
description: Protocol candidate v0.16 says invitation materials explain the deadline for withdrawal before analysis lock; participant-facing materials promise withdrawal before analysis begins.
reason: Align the protocol documentation to the earlier and safer participant-facing commitment.
affected_records_or_outputs: Documentation candidate only; no participant record or analytical output affected.
temporary_action: Do not treat v0.16 as the final submission copy; prepare a hand-maintained v0.17 replacing only the withdrawal-deadline phrase.
resolution: Applied in Validation_Protocol_PreReg_v0.17.docx: the participant-withdrawal sentence now says “before analysis begins”; the unrelated analytical-freeze use of “analysis lock” remains unchanged.

description: Corrected an unsatisfiable self-referential Git-commit check in the Gate 2 enforcement implementation. The revised guard validates the direct parent of the authorisation commit as the frozen implementation basis.
reason: The prior guard required the receipt basis commit to equal both the manifest implementation-check commit and execution-time HEAD even though the receipt and gate-state change must be committed first.
affected_records_or_outputs: No sample or assignment output; no Record ID; no registered packet artefact; no scientific input or study decision affected.
temporary_action: Replace execution-time HEAD equality with the A-to-B direct-parent handshake; require a tracked canonical JSON receipt and restrict commit B to the explicit administrative allowlist.
resolution: Implemented and synthetic-tested the direct-parent guard. No sampling rule, seed, population, exclusion, stratum, draw order, instrument or analysis decision changed, and no sample had been drawn.

description: Corrected stale SHA-256 guards and preregistration-manifest identities caused by inconsistent CRLF and LF representations. Corrections used three distinct evidential bases: exact reproduction of recorded hashes by converting current LF bytes to CRLF; separate investigation of RED-079, whose recorded digest matched no committed version of the file and no other blob at commit d51e5512 in any tested encoding and is therefore presumed to represent an unrecoverable intermediate authoring state; and correction of candidate 0.3 internal guards after reproducing their historical CRLF identities from current LF content.
reason: .gitattributes mandates LF for the affected text artefacts but several digests had been recorded from CRLF representations; RED-079 had instead recorded a digest that could not be associated with any committed artefact.
affected_records_or_outputs: Hash guards and manifest metadata only. The frozen classification output remained 1,308 records and every substantive_domains, analytical_purpose and cross_cutting_tags value was identical between representations. No dictionary content, classification value, sample, assignment, participant record or analytical output changed.
temporary_action: Halted candidate 0.4 generation while each mismatch was classified; updated only guards proven representational and separately investigated the unreproducible RED-079 digest.
resolution: Updated the affected guards and manifest rows to the working-tree LF identities with dated explanatory comments; propagated the candidate 0.3 builder identity; and verified that all predecessor pins and controlled manifest rows resolve without changing scientific content.

description: The protocol states that values in fields hidden after a changed parent response are preserved but excluded from derived variables. Controlled live testing in PID 9149 showed that REDCap instead deletes those child values without warning when the parent response changes.
reason: The protocol and analysis plan assumed retained hidden values; the deployed REDCap behaviour is deletion rather than retention.
affected_records_or_outputs: The finding arose during synthetic live QA, so no participant data were affected when it was identified. This is not confined to QA: the same REDCap behaviour will apply to every real owner response in which a changed parent answer hides a populated child field. The child value will be deleted rather than retained, affecting the raw export and the factual basis of the §8.6 derivation rule.
temporary_action: Treat hidden child values as deleted or blank rather than retained; do not infer retained data; amend the protocol and corresponding analysis documentation before recruitment and analysis.
resolution: Resolved by amendment AMD-001 (preregistration/post_registration/amendments/AMD-001_owner_hidden_follow_up_values.md, 2026-10-16): the protocol v1.1 section 8.6 sentence now states that REDCap deletes the value of a field hidden by a changed parent response, so no hidden value is retained, and that derived completion and analysis variables are evaluated under the final branching state. The owner analysis implementation reads final values only and needed no change. The closing owner export of 13 October 2026 was checked before any substantive owner analysis: of 319 populated values across the 47 branched fields, none lies in a field hidden under the final branching state. The amendment was made after owner recruitment and data collection but before analysis; no derived variable or result is affected.

study_stage: project-owner data collection (post-registration, recruitment waves complete)
protocol_section: Project-owner recruitment: data collection closes 42 days after the first invitations; withdrawal deadline stated in the participant information
description: Project-owner data collection will close on Monday 12 October 2026, 49 days after the first invitations on 24 August 2026, instead of 42 days (Monday 5 October) as the protocol specifies. The withdrawal deadline moves from Monday 19 October to Monday 26 October 2026, keeping the 14-day interval stated in the participant information.
reason: To increase the number of Record IDs with complete owner reviews towards the protocol's target of at least 50, since owners in the later recruitment waves (invited 15 and 23 September) had less time than the first wave; the study lead is also unavailable to close collection on 5 October. Decided before the original close date and before any substantive analysis of owner responses.
affected_records_or_outputs: Timing only. No change to the frozen owner sequence, the owners invited, their assignments, the owner instrument's questions or the analysis plan. Reviews submitted from 6 to 12 October are included. Substantive analysis of owner responses, and the adjudication routes that depend on them, begin after 26 October instead of 19 October.
temporary_action: Reminders from 30 September state the 12 October close. The dates in the live owner instrument's information text and consent statement (5 October close, 19 October withdrawal) were left unchanged, and 26 October is the working withdrawal date for every owner: withdrawal requests received up to 26 October are honoured, whichever wording the owner consented under.
resolution: Applied. The UCL Research Ethics Committee was not consulted: the study lead judged that the change asks nothing more of participants, since it gives owners a longer window to respond and to withdraw, and changes no approved participant-facing document (the information sheet and consent wording were left as approved). An earlier close or a shorter withdrawal window would have been referred to the committee.

study_stage: project-owner analysis preparation (data collection closed 13 October 2026; withdrawal window open to 26 October 2026)
protocol_section: Project-owner participation and data handling: the withdrawal deadline precedes analysis, with analysis beginning when substantive analysis of project-owner responses starts
description: Substantive analysis of project-owner responses, and the construction and adjudication of owner-derived adjudication records (route 2), may begin before the withdrawal deadline of Monday 26 October 2026 (DEV-005), instead of after it.
reason: To avoid holding up the owner analyses and adjudication while the withdrawal window runs; withdrawals are expected to be rare. The commitment made to participants, that a review withdrawn by the deadline is removed, is kept in full.
affected_records_or_outputs: Project-owner analyses and the route-2 adjudication population. If a withdrawal request is received by 26 October 2026, the owner's reviews are removed from the analysis dataset and every owner analysis is re-run from a fresh export, and records that entered adjudication only through that owner's reviews are removed from the adjudication population. The secondary-review audit draw is taken only after 26 October 2026, so that the adjudication universe is final before it is sampled. No owner-derived result is shared outside the study team before 26 October 2026.
temporary_action: Owner analyses are scripted and re-runnable from the export; withdrawals are applied as described; the audit draw waits for 26 October 2026.
resolution: Open until 26 October 2026 passes; then record whether any withdrawal was received and how it was applied.
